findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous function calls within jmespath
 * @description Checking for potentially dangerous function calls within the jmespath package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/dangerous-function-calls
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("__import__").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("getattr").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("setattr").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("delattr").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("globals").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("locals").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially dangerous function call that could be used for code injection or other security issues."
findings.hypothesis: Looking for dangerous function calls within jmespath package that could lead to code injection
